text: AWS Security Weekly Radar | A heavy week for AI tooling CVEs, plus practical wins in detection: GuardDuty by organization policy and grouped remediation in Security Hub.

text.text: *A heavy week for AI tooling CVEs, plus practical wins in detection: GuardDuty by organization policy and grouped remediation in Security Hub.*

🟠 `NEWS` *<https://aws.amazon.com/about-aws/whats-new/2026/10/aws-security-hub-remediation-plans/|AWS Security Hub introduces remediation plans to prioritize and fix security exposures>* _(2026-10-01)_
*Why it matters:* Remediation plans group exposure findings by root cause, so one fix can close several exposures. Each plan comes with step-by-step guidance in CLI, Terraform, CloudFormation and CDK.
*Suggested action:* Use the critical and high plans as next sprint's backlog and keep the fixes in IaC.

🟠 `NEWS` *<https://aws.amazon.com/about-aws/whats-new/2026/10/guardduty-org-enablement-policies/|Amazon GuardDuty now supports centralized management using AWS Organizations declarative policies>* _(2026-10-01)_
*Why it matters:* GuardDuty can now be enabled through an AWS Organizations declarative policy, which covers existing accounts and every new one without custom automation.
*Suggested action:* Replace enablement scripts with the declarative policy and check coverage per account and Region.

🟠 `NEWS` *<https://aws.amazon.com/about-aws/whats-new/2026/10/aws-security-hub-runtime-monitoring/|GuardDuty Runtime Monitoring is now included in the AWS Security Hub Threat Analytics plan>* _(2026-10-02)_
*Why it matters:* Runtime Monitoring is now part of the Security Hub Threat Analytics plan, with no separate GuardDuty charge where Security Hub is on.
*Suggested action:* Review runtime coverage for EC2, EKS and Fargate and remove duplicate billing.

🟠 `NEWS` *<https://aws.amazon.com/about-aws/whats-new/2026/10/aws-continuum-penetration-testing/|AWS Continuum for Penetration Testing now supports continuous penetration testing integrated directly into your CI/CD pipeline>* _(2026-10-05)_
*Why it matters:* AWS Continuum can run penetration tests inside CI/CD pipelines (public preview), moving testing from yearly to every change.
*Suggested action:* Pilot it on a non-critical repository and compare findings with your last external pentest.

⚪ `NEWS` *<https://aws.amazon.com/about-aws/whats-new/2026/10/aws-private-ca-certificate-issuance-logs/|AWS Private CA now provides detailed certificate issuance logs>* _(2026-10-05)_
*Why it matters:* Private CA now logs every issued certificate in CloudTrail, including content, issuing CA and requester. Audit evidence for your PKI without manual collection.
*Suggested action:* Route these events to your audit trail and alert on unexpected issuers.

⚪ `NEWS` *<https://aws.amazon.com/about-aws/whats-new/2026/10/aws-identity-store-network-controls/|AWS IAM Identity Center now supports network access controls for Identity Store>* _(2026-10-05)_
*Why it matters:* You can restrict the Identity Store and SCIM APIs by source network, closing a path for changing users and groups from outside your network.
*Suggested action:* Allow only your identity provider and provisioning automation ranges.
